actions.name: get_presentation
actions.description: Get all slides from a presentation

actions.name: refresh_sheets_charts
actions.description: Refresh all Google Sheets charts in the presentation

actions.name: generate_from_template
actions.description: Generate a new slide from a template

actions.name: create_presentation
actions.description: Create a new, empty Google Slides presentation, optionally in a Drive folder.

actions.name: copy_presentation
actions.description: Make a copy of a presentation, optionally with a new name and folder.

actions.name: find_presentations
actions.description: Search Google Drive for presentations by name and/or folder.

actions.name: get_presentation_outline
actions.description: Get each slide's number, object ID, title, text and speaker notes.

actions.name: get_slide
actions.description: Get one slide with all of its elements.

actions.name: get_slide_thumbnail
actions.description: Get a PNG image of a slide, as a link and optionally as a file.

actions.name: add_slide
actions.description: Add a new slide with a layout, and optionally fill its title and body.

actions.name: duplicate_slide
actions.description: Copy a slide within the same presentation.

actions.name: move_slide
actions.description: Move a slide to a new position in the presentation.

actions.name: delete_slide
actions.description: Delete a slide from the presentation.

actions.name: replace_text
actions.description: Replace every occurrence of a text in the presentation.

actions.name: replace_shapes_with_image
actions.description: Replace every shape that contains a text (e.g. {{logo}}) with an image from a URL.

actions.name: insert_image
actions.description: Add an image from a URL to a slide.

actions.name: set_speaker_notes
actions.description: Replace the speaker notes of a slide.

actions.name: export_presentation
actions.description: Download a presentation as a PDF, PowerPoint, OpenDocument or plain-text file.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
